capabilities: embed font files from a vault folder without installing them on the OS
assign separate fonts to interface, text, and monospace roles
build ordered fallback font chains for mixed scripts
group weight files into a family so bold and italic resolve automatically
apply per-note fonts via cssclasses or CSS utility classes
extras: Dynamic CSS via adoptedStyleSheets requires iOS/Safari 16.4+ on mobile; a standalone web-based font-to-Base64 converter is offered for users who only want the conversion or hit performance issues.
intentEvidence: Obsidian doesn't make it easy to set custom fonts — especially on Android and iOS.
problem: Obsidian makes setting custom fonts difficult, especially on Android and iOS, where fonts normally have to be installed on the device.

relations.evidence: References - Embed fonts and images in your theme - Developer Documentation
relations.plugin: Embed fonts and images in your theme - Developer Documentation

summary: Font loader that embeds custom fonts from a vault folder and applies them to interface, text, and monospace roles on all platforms including mobile.
